seeded_failure.symptom: New users see dates formatted as MM/DD/YYYY and currency in USD even though the company operating currency and primary office are in the UK.
seeded_failure.cause: The default org locale and default corporate currency were left unchanged at US defaults during initial org setup.
seeded_failure.fix: Navigate to Setup > Company Information, edit Organization Defaults, set Default Locale to English (United Kingdom) and Currency to GBP, then save.
